+# Explicación Completa del Código - Music Player
 
+## Resumen General
+
+Has creado un reproductor de música profesional para Android que:
+
+- ✅ Lee música real del dispositivo
+- ✅ Reproduce en segundo plano
+- ✅ Tiene una UI moderna con Jetpack Compose
+- ✅ Usa Clean Architecture (código organizado y escalable)
+
+## ️ ¿Qué es Clean Architecture?
+
+Imagina que estás construyendo una casa:
+
+- **Cimientos (Domain)**: La base, las reglas del negocio que nunca cambian
+- **Paredes (Data)**: Cómo obtienes y guardas datos (puede cambiar)
+- **Decoración (Presentation)**: La UI, lo que el usuario ve
+
+**Ventaja**: Si quieres cambiar la decoración, no tienes que tocar los cimientos.
+
+---
+
+## Estructura del Proyecto
+
+```
+app/src/main/java/com/example/mediasessionplayer/
+│
+├── domain/ # CAPA DE DOMINIO (Reglas de negocio)
+│ ├── model/
+│ │ ├── Song.kt # Representa una canción
+│ │ ├── PlayerState.kt # Estado del reproductor
+│ │ └── PlaybackState.kt # Estados de reproducción
+│ │
+│ ├── repository/ # Interfaces (contratos)
+│ │ ├── MusicRepository.kt
+│ │ └── PlayerRepository.kt
+│ │
+│ └── usecase/ # Acciones que puede hacer el usuario
+│ ├── GetSongsUseCase.kt
+│ ├── PlaySongUseCase.kt
+│ ├── GetPlayerStateUseCase.kt
+│ └── ControlPlaybackUseCase.kt
+│
+├── data/ # CAPA DE DATOS (Implementación)
+│ ├── source/
+│ │ └── LocalMusicDataSource.kt # Lee música del dispositivo
+│ │
+│ ├── repository/ # Implementación de interfaces
+│ │ ├── MusicRepositoryImpl.kt
+│ │ └── PlayerRepositoryImpl.kt
+│ │
+│ └── service/
+│ └── MusicService.kt # Servicio de reproducción en background
+│
+├── presentation/ # CAPA DE PRESENTACIÓN (UI)
+│ ├── viewmodel/
+│ │ └── MusicPlayerViewModel.kt # Lógica de la UI
+│ │
+│ └── ui/
+│ └── MusicPlayerScreen.kt # Interfaz con Compose
+│
+└── di/ # Inyección de Dependencias
+ └── AppModule.kt # Configuración de Hilt
+```
+
+---
+
+## Explicación Archivo por Archivo
+
+### 1. Domain Layer (Dominio)
+
+#### `Song.kt` - ¿Qué es una canción?
+
+```kotlin
+data class Song(
+ val id: String, // ID único (ej: "12345")
+ val title: String, // Título (ej: "Bohemian Rhapsody")
+ val artist: String, // Artista (ej: "Queen")
+ val album: String, // Álbum (ej: "A Night at the Opera")
+ val duration: Long, // Duración en milisegundos (ej: 354000 = 5:54)
+ val imageUrl: String, // URL de la carátula
+ val mediaUri: String // Ubicación del archivo de audio
+)
+```
+
+**Explicación simple**: Es como una ficha con toda la información de una canción.
+
+#### `PlayerState.kt` - ¿En qué estado está el reproductor?
+
+```kotlin
+data class PlayerState(
+ val currentSong: Song? = null, // ¿Qué canción está sonando?
+ val isPlaying: Boolean = false, // ¿Está reproduciendo o pausado?
+ val playbackState: PlaybackState, // Estado técnico
+ val currentPosition: Long = 0L, // En qué segundo va (ej: 30000 = 0:30)
+ val duration: Long = 0L // Duración total
+)
+```
+
+**Explicación simple**: Es como el panel de control que te dice todo sobre lo que está pasando.
+
+#### `MusicRepository.kt` - Interface (Contrato)
+
+```kotlin
+interface MusicRepository {
+ suspend fun getSongs(): List<Song> // Dame todas las canciones
+ fun getSongById(id: String): Song? // Dame una canción específica
+}
+```
+
+**Explicación simple**: Es como un menú de restaurante. Te dice qué puedes pedir, pero no cómo lo
+cocinan.
+
+#### `GetSongsUseCase.kt` - Caso de Uso
+
+```kotlin
+class GetSongsUseCase @Inject constructor(
+ private val repository: MusicRepository
+) {
+ suspend operator fun invoke(): List<Song> {
+ return repository.getSongs()
+ }
+}
+```
+
+**Explicación simple**:
+
+- El usuario quiere ver sus canciones
+- Este caso de uso dice: "Ve al repositorio y tráeme las canciones"
+- Es como un mesero que toma tu orden y va a la cocina
+
+**¿Por qué usar Use Cases?**
+
+```kotlin
+// ❌ Sin Use Case - Lógica en el ViewModel
+fun loadSongs() {
+ val songs = repository.getSongs()
+ // Filtrar canciones corruptas
+ // Ordenar por fecha
+ // Log analytics
+}
+
+// ✅ Con Use Case - Lógica encapsulada
+fun loadSongs() {
+ getSongsUseCase() // Todo está dentro del Use Case
+}
+```
+
+---
+
+### 2. Data Layer (Datos)
+
+#### `LocalMusicDataSource.kt` - Leer música del dispositivo
+
+```kotlin
+@Singleton
+class LocalMusicDataSource @Inject constructor(
+ @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
+) {
+ fun getLocalSongs(): List<Song> {
+ val songs = mutableListOf<Song>()
+ 
+ // 1. Definir qué información queremos
+ val projection = arrayOf(
+ MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID, // ID
+ MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE, // Título
+ MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST, // Artista
+ // etc...
+ )
+ 
+ // 2. Hacer la consulta al sistema
+ val cursor = context.contentResolver.query(
+ MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, // Dónde buscar
+ projection, // Qué buscar
+ "${MediaStore.Audio.Media.IS_MUSIC} != 0", // Filtro: solo música
+ null,
+ "${MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE} ASC" // Orden alfabético
+ )
+ 
+ // 3. Leer los resultados
+ cursor?.use {
+ while (it.moveToNext()) {
+ // Extraer información de cada fila
+ val id = it.getLong(idColumn)
+ val title = it.getString(titleColumn)
+ // ...
+ 
+ // Crear objeto Song
+ songs.add(Song(...))
+ }
+ }
+ 
+ return songs
+ }
+}
+```
+
+**Explicación simple**:
+
+- **MediaStore** es como el índice de biblioteca de Android
+- Le preguntamos: "Dame todos los archivos de música"
+- Nos devuelve un **Cursor** (como una tabla de Excel)
+- Leemos fila por fila y creamos objetos `Song`
+
+**¿Cómo funciona el ContentResolver?**
+
+```
+Tu App ────query()────▶ ContentResolver ────▶ Sistema Android
+ │
+ ▼
+ Base de datos de medios
+ │
+ ▼
+Tu App ◀───Cursor───── ContentResolver ◀─────── Resultados
+```
+
+#### `PlayerRepositoryImpl.kt` - Controlar reproducción
+
+```kotlin
+@Singleton
+class PlayerRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
+ @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
+) : PlayerRepository {
+ 
+ private var mediaController: MediaController? = null
+ 
+ // Estado que otros pueden observar
+ private val _playerState = MutableStateFlow(PlayerState())
+ override val playerState: Flow<PlayerState> = _playerState.asStateFlow()
+ 
+ init {
+ initializeController() // Conectar al servicio
+ }
+ 
+ private fun initializeController() {
+ // 1. Crear token para conectarse al servicio
+ val sessionToken = SessionToken(
+ context,
+ ComponentName(context, MusicService::class.java)
+ )
+ 
+ // 2. Construir MediaController (es asíncrono)
+ controllerFuture = MediaController.Builder(context, sessionToken)
+ .buildAsync()
+ 
+ // 3. Cuando esté listo
+ controllerFuture?.addListener({
+ mediaController = controllerFuture?.get()
+ setupPlayerListener()
+ startPositionUpdates() // Empezar a actualizar posición
+ }, MoreExecutors.directExecutor())
+ }
+ 
+ // Escuchar cambios del reproductor
+ private fun setupPlayerListener() {
+ mediaController?.addListener(object : Player.Listener {
+ override fun onIsPlayingChanged(isPlaying: Boolean) {
+ _playerState.value = _playerState.value.copy(
+ isPlaying = isPlaying
+ )
+ }
+ })
+ }
+ 
+ // Actualizar posición cada segundo
+ private fun startPositionUpdates() {
+ positionUpdateJob = coroutineScope.launch {
+ while (isActive) {
+ val position = mediaController?.currentPosition ?: 0L
+ _playerState.value = _playerState.value.copy(
+ currentPosition = position
+ )
+ delay(1000) // Esperar 1 segundo
+ }
+ }
+ }
+}
+```
+
+**Explicación simple**:
+
+1. **MediaController**: Es como un control remoto para el reproductor
+2. **Player.Listener**: Es como tener notificaciones cuando algo cambia
+3. **Coroutine**: Un "loop" que se ejecuta cada segundo para actualizar la posición
+
+**¿Por qué se actualiza la UI automáticamente?**
+
+```
+MediaController
+ │
+ │ currentPosition = 30s
+ ▼
+_playerState.value = ...copy(currentPosition = 30s)
+ │
+ │ Flow emite cambio
+ ▼
+ViewModel observa el Flow
+ │
+ │ StateFlow actualizado
+ ▼
+UI (Compose) observa StateFlow
+ │
+ │ collectAsState() detecta cambio
+ ▼
+UI se RECOMPONE (actualiza automáticamente)
+```
+
+#### `MusicService.kt` - Servicio de reproducción
+
+```kotlin
+@AndroidEntryPoint
+class MusicService : MediaSessionService() {
+ 
+ private var mediaSession: MediaSession? = null
+ 
+ @Inject
+ lateinit var player: ExoPlayer
+ 
+ override fun onCreate() {
+ super.onCreate()
+ 
+ // Crear la sesión de media
+ mediaSession = MediaSession.Builder(this, player)
+ .build()
+ }
+ 
+ override fun onGetSession(
+ controllerInfo: MediaSession.ControllerInfo
+ ): MediaSession? {
+ return mediaSession
+ }
+ 
+ override fun onDestroy() {
+ mediaSession?.run {
+ player.release()
+ release()
+ mediaSession = null
+ }
+ super.onDestroy()
+ }
+}
+```
+
+**Explicación simple**:
+
+- Es un **servicio** que corre en segundo plano (como WhatsApp que recibe mensajes aunque no esté
+ abierto)
+- **ExoPlayer**: El motor que realmente reproduce el audio
+- **MediaSession**: Permite que el sistema Android controle el reproductor (notificaciones,
+ Bluetooth, etc.)
+
+**¿Por qué MediaSessionService?**
+
+```
+App Normal:
+Usuario cierra app ────▶ Música se detiene ❌
+
+MediaSessionService:
+Usuario cierra app ────▶ Música sigue sonando ✅
+ Aparece notificación ✅
+ Controles en lock screen ✅
+ Botones de audífonos funcionan ✅
+```
+
+---
+
+### 3. Presentation Layer (Presentación)
+
+#### `MusicPlayerViewModel.kt` - Lógica de la UI
+
+```kotlin
+@HiltViewModel
+class MusicPlayerViewModel @Inject constructor(
+ private val getSongsUseCase: GetSongsUseCase,
+ private val controlPlaybackUseCase: ControlPlaybackUseCase,
+ getPlayerStateUseCase: GetPlayerStateUseCase
+) : ViewModel() {
+ 
+ // Lista de canciones (observable)
+ private val _songs = MutableStateFlow<List<Song>>(emptyList())
+ val songs: StateFlow<List<Song>> = _songs.asStateFlow()
+ 
+ // Estado del reproductor (observable)
+ val playerState: StateFlow<PlayerState> = getPlayerStateUseCase()
+ .stateIn(
+ scope = viewModelScope,
+ started = SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000),
+ initialValue = PlayerState()
+ )
+ 
+ // Cargar canciones
+ fun loadSongs() {
+ viewModelScope.launch {
+ _songs.value = getSongsUseCase()
+ }
+ }
+ 
+ // Reproducir canción
+ fun playSong(song: Song) {
+ val index = _songs.value.indexOf(song)
+ controlPlaybackUseCase.setPlaylist(_songs.value, index)
+ }
+ 
+ // Play/Pause
+ fun playPause() {
+ if (playerState.value.isPlaying) {
+ controlPlaybackUseCase.pause()
+ } else {
+ controlPlaybackUseCase.play()
+ }
+ }
+}
+```
+
+**Explicación simple**:
+
+- El **ViewModel** es como el cerebro de la pantalla
+- Guarda los datos (canciones, estado)
+- Maneja las acciones del usuario (play, pause, etc.)
+- **Sobrevive** a rotaciones de pantalla
+
+**¿Por qué ViewModel?**
+
+```
+Sin ViewModel:
+Rotas el teléfono ────▶ Activity se destruye ────▶ Pierdes datos ❌
+
+Con ViewModel:
+Rotas el teléfono ────▶ Activity se destruye ────▶ ViewModel sobrevive ✅
+ Activity se recrea ────▶ Recupera datos ✅
+```
+
+#### `MusicPlayerScreen.kt` - Interfaz gráfica
+
+```kotlin
+@Composable
+fun MusicPlayerScreen(viewModel: MusicPlayerViewModel) {
+ // Observar cambios
+ val songs by viewModel.songs.collectAsState()
+ val playerState by viewModel.playerState.collectAsState()
+ 
+ Column {
+ // Lista de canciones
+ LazyColumn(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
+ items(songs) { song ->
+ SongItem(
+ song = song,
+ isPlaying = playerState.currentSong?.id == song.id,
+ onClick = { viewModel.playSong(song) }
+ )
+ }
+ }
+ 
+ // Mini reproductor en la parte inferior
+ playerState.currentSong?.let { song ->
+ MiniPlayer(
+ currentSong = song,
+ isPlaying = playerState.isPlaying,
+ currentPosition = playerState.currentPosition,
+ duration = playerState.duration,
+ onPlayPauseClick = { viewModel.playPause() },
+ onSkipNext = { viewModel.skipToNext() },
+ onSkipPrevious = { viewModel.skipToPrevious() },
+ onSeek = { viewModel.seekTo(it) }
+ )
+ }
+ }
+}
+```
+
+**Explicación simple**:
+
+- **@Composable**: Funciones que dibujan la UI
+- **collectAsState()**: Observa cambios y redibuja automáticamente
+- **LazyColumn**: Lista eficiente (solo renderiza lo visible)
+
+**¿Cómo funciona la recomposición?**
+
+```
+1. playerState.currentPosition = 30s
+2. collectAsState() detecta cambio
+3. Compose RE-EJECUTA MiniPlayer
+4. Slider se dibuja en nueva posición
+5. UI actualizada ✅
+
+Todo esto sucede automáticamente, sin código adicional!
+```
+
+---
+
+### 4. Dependency Injection (Hilt)
+
+#### `AppModule.kt` - Configuración
+
+```kotlin
+@Module
+@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
+abstract class AppModule {
+ 
+ @Binds
+ @Singleton
+ abstract fun bindMusicRepository(
+ musicRepositoryImpl: MusicRepositoryImpl
+ ): MusicRepository
+ 
+ @Binds
+ @Singleton
+ abstract fun bindPlayerRepository(
+ playerRepositoryImpl: PlayerRepositoryImpl
+ ): PlayerRepository
+}
+```
+
+**Explicación simple**:
+
+- **Hilt** es como un mayordomo que entrega las cosas que necesitas
+- En lugar de crear objetos manualmente, Hilt los crea y entrega automáticamente
+
+**Sin Hilt vs Con Hilt:**
+
+```kotlin
+// ❌ Sin Hilt - Manual
+class MusicPlayerViewModel {
+ private val dataSource = LocalMusicDataSource(context)
+ private val repository = MusicRepositoryImpl(dataSource)
+ private val useCase = GetSongsUseCase(repository)
+}
+
+// ✅ Con Hilt - Automático
+@HiltViewModel
+class MusicPlayerViewModel @Inject constructor(
+ private val getSongsUseCase: GetSongsUseCase // Hilt lo provee
+) : ViewModel()
+```
+

+
+## Flujo Completo: "Usuario reproduce una canción"
+
+### Paso a Paso:
+
+```
+1. USUARIO toca una canción en la lista
+ │
+ ▼
+2. UI llama viewModel.playSong(song)
+ │
+ ▼
+3. ViewModel llama controlPlaybackUseCase.setPlaylist()
+ │
+ ▼
+4. Use Case llama playerRepository.setPlaylist()
+ │
+ ▼
+5. PlayerRepository llama mediaController.setMediaItems()
+ │
+ ▼
+6. MediaController envía comando a MusicService (IPC)
+ │
+ ▼
+7. MusicService recibe comando y usa ExoPlayer
+ │
+ ▼
+8. ExoPlayer empieza a reproducir el archivo de audio
+ │
+ ▼
+9. Player.Listener detecta cambio (onIsPlayingChanged)
+ │
+ ▼
+10. PlayerRepository actualiza _playerState
+ │
+ ▼
+11. Flow emite nuevo estado
+ │
+ ▼
+12. ViewModel recibe actualización
+ │
+ ▼
+13. UI observa cambio con collectAsState()
+ │
+ ▼
+14. Compose RECOMPONE la UI
+ │
+ ▼
+15. Usuario ve: ✅ Canción marcada como reproduciendo
+ ✅ Botón cambia a "Pause"
+ ✅ Slider empieza a moverse
+```
+
+---
+
+## ¿Cómo funciona Jetpack Compose?
+
+### Concepto clave: Recomposición
+
+```kotlin
+@Composable
+fun Counter() {
+ var count by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
+ 
+ Button(onClick = { count++ }) {
+ Text("Clicked $count times")
+ }
+}
+```
+
+**¿Qué pasa cuando tocas el botón?**
+
+```
+1. count++ ejecuta
+2. Estado cambia: count = 1
+3. Compose detecta cambio
+4. RE-EJECUTA Counter()
+5. Text se redibuja con nuevo valor
+6. Usuario ve "Clicked 1 times"
+```
+
+**En nuestro reproductor:**
+
+```kotlin
+val playerState by viewModel.playerState.collectAsState()
+
+Text("${formatTime(playerState.currentPosition)}")
+```
+
+Cada segundo:
+
+1. playerState.currentPosition actualiza
+2. Compose detecta cambio
+3. Text se redibuja
+4. Usuario ve tiempo actualizado
+
+---
+
+## Estados y Flows
+
+### ¿Qué es un Flow?
+
+Imagina un Flow como una **tubería de agua**:
+
+- El agua son los datos
+- La tubería es el Flow
+- Tu UI es el grifo que recibe el agua
+
+```kotlin
+// Crear el "grifo" (fuente)
+private val _playerState = MutableStateFlow(PlayerState())
+
+// Exponer la "tubería" (solo lectura)
+val playerState: Flow<PlayerState> = _playerState.asStateFlow()
+
+// Cambiar el agua
+_playerState.value = PlayerState(isPlaying = true)
+
+// Recibir agua en la UI
+val state by playerState.collectAsState()
+```
+
+### Tipos de Flows:
+
+1. **MutableStateFlow**: Puedes leer y escribir
+2. **StateFlow**: Solo puedes leer (inmutable)
+3. **Flow**: Stream genérico
+
+---
+
+## Beneficios de Esta Arquitectura
+
+### 1. Testeable
+
+```kotlin
+// Puedes probar cada capa independientemente
+@Test
+fun `test play song`() {
+ val mockRepo = mockk<PlayerRepository>()
+ val useCase = PlaySongUseCase(mockRepo)
+ 
+ useCase(testSong)
+ 
+ verify { mockRepo.playSong(testSong) }
+}
+```
+
+### 2. Mantenible
+
+```kotlin
+// Necesitas cambiar cómo obtienes canciones?
+// Solo modifica MusicRepositoryImpl
+// ViewModel y UI NO cambian!
+```
+
+### 3. Escalable
+
+```kotlin
+// ¿Quieres agregar Spotify?
+class SpotifyDataSource { }
+
+class MusicRepositoryImpl(
+ private val local: LocalMusicDataSource,
+ private val spotify: SpotifyDataSource // Solo agregar!
+) { }
+```
+
+### 4. Reutilizable
+
+```kotlin
+// Use Cases se pueden usar en múltiples pantallas
+class PlaylistScreen {
+ fun play() = playSongUseCase(song) // Mismo Use Case!
+}
+```
+

+
+## Conceptos Clave de Android
+
+### 1. MediaStore
+
+- Base de datos de archivos multimedia del sistema
+- Acceso a música, videos, imágenes
+- No necesitas permisos para leer metadata básica (Android 10+)
+
+### 2. ContentProvider
+
+- Mecanismo para compartir datos entre apps
+- MediaStore es un ContentProvider
+- Usas `ContentResolver` para consultar
+
+### 3. MediaSession
+
+- Framework para control de medios
+- Integra con:
+ - Notificaciones
+ - Pantalla de bloqueo
+ - Android Auto
+ - Wear OS
+ - Asistentes de voz
+
+### 4. ExoPlayer (parte de Media3)
+
+- Reproductor de audio/video potente
+- Soporta múltiples formatos
+- Streaming, caching, DRM
+
+### 5. Coroutines
+
+- Programación asíncrona en Kotlin
+- Evita bloquear la UI
+- Manejo simple de operaciones largas
+
+### 6. Hilt
+
+- Inyección de dependencias automática
+- Menos código boilerplate
+- Ciclo de vida automático
+
+---
+
+## Preguntas Frecuentes
+
+### ¿Por qué tantas capas?
+
+**Sin capas:**
+
+```kotlin
+class MainActivity {
+ fun loadSongs() {
+ // Query MediaStore directamente
+ // Actualizar UI
+ // Manejar errores
+ // Log analytics
+ // Guardar en caché
+ // Todo mezclado! ❌
+ }
+}
+```
+
+**Con capas:**
+
+```kotlin
+class MainActivity {
+ fun loadSongs() {
+ viewModel.loadSongs() // Simple y limpio ✅
+ }
+}
+```
+
+### ¿Por qué usar interfaces?
+
+Permite **cambiar implementaciones**:
+
+```kotlin
+// Desarrollo: Datos falsos
+class FakeMusicRepository : MusicRepository
+
+// Producción: Datos reales
+class RealMusicRepository : MusicRepository
+
+// Testing: Datos mockeados
+class MockMusicRepository : MusicRepository
+```
+
+### ¿Qué es IPC (Inter-Process Communication)?
+
+Tu app y el servicio corren en **procesos separados**:
+
+```
+App Process MusicService Process
+ │ │
+ │──── play() ──────────▶│
+ │ │ reproduce
+ │◀── onIsPlaying ───────│
+ │ │
+```
+

+# Material Icons Extended - Referencia
 
+Este documento te ayuda a entender y usar los iconos de Material Design en el proyecto.
+
+## ¿Qué es Material Icons Extended?
+
+`material-icons-extended` es una biblioteca que proporciona **más de 2,000 iconos** de Material
+Design para usar en Jetpack Compose.
+
+### Diferencia entre paquetes de iconos:
+
+| Paquete | Iconos incluidos | Tamaño |
+|---------|------------------|--------|
+| `material-icons-core` | ~100 iconos básicos | ~50 KB |
+| `material-icons-extended` | +2,000 iconos | ~1.5 MB |
+
+**En este proyecto usamos `extended`** para tener acceso a todos los iconos.
+
+## Iconos Usados en el Reproductor
+
+### Controles de Reproducción
+
+```kotlin
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.PlayArrow
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Pause
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.SkipNext
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.SkipPrevious
+
+// Botón Play
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
+ contentDescription = "Play",
+ tint = Color.White
+)
+
+// Botón Pause
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.Pause,
+ contentDescription = "Pause",
+ tint = Color.White
+)
+
+// Siguiente canción
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipNext,
+ contentDescription = "Next",
+ tint = Color.White
+)
+
+// Canción anterior
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipPrevious,
+ contentDescription = "Previous",
+ tint = Color.White
+)
+```
+
+### Ícono de Música
+
+```kotlin
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.MusicNote
+
+// Ícono predeterminado cuando no hay carátula
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.MusicNote,
+ contentDescription = "Music",
+ modifier = Modifier.size(48.dp),
+ tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
+)
+```
+
+## Iconos Adicionales Útiles para Reproductores
+
+### Control de Volumen
+
+```kotlin
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.VolumeUp
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.VolumeDown
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.VolumeMute
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.VolumeOff
+```
+
+### Modos de Reproducción
+
+```kotlin
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Shuffle // Aleatorio
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Repeat // Repetir
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.RepeatOne // Repetir una
+```
+
+### Listas y Favoritos
+
+```kotlin
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Favorite // Favorito
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.FavoriteBorder // No favorito
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.PlaylistAdd // Agregar a playlist
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.PlaylistPlay // Ver playlist
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.QueueMusic // Cola de reproducción
+```
+
+### Búsqueda y Navegación
+
+```kotlin
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Search // Buscar
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Close // Cerrar
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Menu // Menú
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.MoreVert // Más opciones
+```
+
+### Información y Ajustes
+
+```kotlin
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Info // Información
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Settings // Configuración
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Equalizer // Ecualizador
+```
+
+## Cómo Usar Iconos
+
+### 1. Básico
+
+```kotlin
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
+ contentDescription = "Play"
+)
+```
+
+### 2. Con Tamaño Personalizado
+
+```kotlin
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
+ contentDescription = "Play",
+ modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
+)
+```
+
+### 3. Con Color Personalizado
+
+```kotlin
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
+ contentDescription = "Play",
+ tint = Color.Blue
+)
+```
+
+### 4. Con Color del Tema
+
+```kotlin
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
+ contentDescription = "Play",
+ tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
+)
+```
+
+### 5. En un Botón
+
+```kotlin
+IconButton(onClick = { /* acción */ }) {
+ Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
+ contentDescription = "Play"
+ )
+}
+```
+
+### 6. En un FloatingActionButton
+
+```kotlin
+FloatingActionButton(onClick = { /* acción */ }) {
+ Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
+ contentDescription = "Play"
+ )
+}
+```
+
+## Buscar Iconos
+
+### Estilos de Iconos
+
+Material Icons viene en 5 estilos:
+
+```kotlin
+Icons.Filled.PlayArrow // Sólido (predeterminado)
+Icons.Outlined.PlayArrow // Contorno
+Icons.Rounded.PlayArrow // Redondeado
+Icons.TwoTone.PlayArrow // Dos tonos
+Icons.Sharp.PlayArrow // Afilado
+```
+
+**En este proyecto usamos `Filled` (sólido).**
+
+### Iconos AutoMirrored
+
+Algunos iconos se voltean automáticamente en idiomas RTL (derecha a izquierda):
+
+```kotlin
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.automirrored.filled.ArrowBack
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.automirrored.filled.ArrowForward
+
+// Se voltea automáticamente en árabe, hebreo, etc.
+Icon(imageVector = Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack)
+```
+
+## Catálogo Completo
+
+Para ver todos los iconos disponibles, visita:
+
+- **Material Design Icons**: https://fonts.google.com/icons
+- **Compose Icons
+ **: https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/androidx/compose/material/icons/package-summary
+
+## Buenas Prácticas
+
+### 1. Siempre usa `contentDescription`
+
+```kotlin
+// ✅ Correcto - Accesible
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
+ contentDescription = "Play"
+)
+
+// ❌ Incorrecto - No accesible
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
+ contentDescription = null
+)
+```
+
+### 2. Usa colores del tema cuando sea posible
+
+```kotlin
+// ✅ Correcto - Se adapta al tema
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
+ tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
+)
+
+// ⚠️ Menos flexible - Color fijo
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
+ tint = Color.Blue
+)
+```
+
+### 3. Importa iconos específicos
+
+```kotlin
+// ✅ Correcto - Imports específicos
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.PlayArrow
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Pause
+
+// ❌ Evitar - Import con wildcard
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.*
+```
+
+### 4. Agrupa iconos relacionados
+
+```kotlin
+// Iconos de reproducción
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.PlayArrow
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Pause
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Stop
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.SkipNext
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.SkipPrevious
+
+// Iconos de favoritos
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Favorite
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.FavoriteBorder
+```
+
+## Agregar Nuevos Iconos
+
+### Paso 1: Buscar el ícono
+
+Visita https://fonts.google.com/icons y busca el ícono que necesitas.
+
+### Paso 2: Verificar disponibilidad
+
+No todos los iconos de Material Design están disponibles en Compose todavía. Verifica en:
+https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/androidx/compose/material/icons/Icons.Filled
+
+### Paso 3: Importar
+
+```kotlin
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.NombreDelIcono
+```
+
+### Paso 4: Usar
+
+```kotlin
+Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.NombreDelIcono,
+ contentDescription = "Descripción"
+)
+```
+
+## Ejemplos Prácticos
+
+### Botón de Shuffle
+
+```kotlin
+var isShuffleEnabled by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
+
+IconButton(onClick = { isShuffleEnabled = !isShuffleEnabled }) {
+ Icon(
+ imageVector = Icons.Filled.Shuffle,
+ contentDescription = if (isShuffleEnabled) "Disable Shuffle" else "Enable Shuffle",
+ tint = if (isShuffleEnabled) 
+ MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary 
+ else 
+ MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
+ )
+}
+```
+
+### Botón de Favorito
+
+```kotlin
+var isFavorite by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
+
+IconButton(onClick = { isFavorite = !isFavorite }) {
+ Icon(
+ imageVector = if (isFavorite) 
+ Icons.Filled.Favorite 
+ else 
+ Icons.Filled.FavoriteBorder,
+ contentDescription = if (isFavorite) "Remove from Favorites" else "Add to Favorites",
+ tint = if (isFavorite) Color.Red else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
+ )
+}
+```
+
+### Control de Volumen
+
+```kotlin
+var volume by remember { mutableStateOf(0.5f) }
+
+Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
+ Icon(
+ imageVector = when {
+ volume == 0f -> Icons.Filled.VolumeOff
+ volume < 0.3f -> Icons.Filled.VolumeMute
+ volume < 0.7f -> Icons.Filled.VolumeDown
+ else -> Icons.Filled.VolumeUp
+ },
+ contentDescription = "Volume"
+ )
+ 
+ Slider(
+ value = volume,
+ onValueChange = { volume = it },
+ modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
+ )
+}
+```
+
+## Optimización
+
+### Reducir el tamaño del APK
+
+Si tu app usa pocos iconos y el tamaño del APK es una preocupación:
+
+```kotlin
+// En lugar de material-icons-extended
+implementation("androidx.compose.material:material-icons-core")
+
+// Y crea tus propios iconos vectoriales para los que necesites
+```
+
+### Crear iconos personalizados
+
+```kotlin
+val CustomIcon = ImageVector.Builder(
+ name = "CustomIcon",
+ defaultWidth = 24.dp,
+ defaultHeight = 24.dp,
+ viewportWidth = 24f,
+ viewportHeight = 24f
+).apply {
+ path(fill = SolidColor(Color.Black)) {
+ // SVG path data
+ }
+}.build()
+```
+
+## Recursos Adicionales
+
+- [Material Design Icons Gallery](https://fonts.google.com/icons)
+- [Compose Icons Documentation](https://developer.android.com/jetpack/compose/graphics/images/material-icons)
+- [Material Design Guidelines](https://m3.material.io/styles/icons)
+
+---
+
+**¡Ahora tienes acceso a más de 2,000 iconos para tu reproductor!** 
+

 isCurrentSong = playerState.currentSong?.id == song.id,
 isPlaying = playerState.isPlaying && playerState.currentSong?.id == song.id,
 onClick = { onSongClick(song) }
 )
 }
 }

 // Player Controls
 if (playerState.currentSong != null) {
 MiniPlayer(
 playerState = playerState,
 onPlayPauseClick = onPlayPauseClick,
 onSkipNext = onSkipNext,
 onSkipPrevious = onSkipPrevious,
 onSeek = onSeek
 )
 }
 }
}

@Composable
fun SongItem(
 song: Song,
 isCurrentSong: Boolean,
 isPlaying: Boolean,
 onClick: () -> Unit,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
 Card(
 modifier = modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .clickable { onClick() },
 elevation = CardDefaults.cardElevation(
 defaultElevation = if (isCurrentSong) 8.dp else 2.dp
 ),
 colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
 containerColor = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
 ),
 shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
 ) {
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(12.dp),
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 // Album Art
 AsyncImage(
 model = song.imageUrl,
 contentDescription = "Album art for ${song.title}",
 modifier = Modifier
 .size(60.dp)
 .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)),
 contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
 )

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(12.dp))

 // Song Info
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
 ) {
 Text(
 text = song.title,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
 color = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
 )
 Text(
 text = song.artist,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
 color = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer.copy(alpha = 0.7f)
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 }

 // Playing indicator
 if (isPlaying) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = "Now playing",
 tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
 modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 }
}

@Composable
fun MiniPlayer(
 playerState: PlayerState,
 onPlayPauseClick: () -> Unit,
 onSkipNext: () -> Unit,
 onSkipPrevious: () -> Unit,
 onSeek: (Long) -> Unit,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
 val song = playerState.currentSong ?: return

 Surface(
 modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant,
 shadowElevation = 8.dp
 ) {
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(16.dp)
 ) {
 // Current Song Info
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 AsyncImage(
 model = song.imageUrl,
 contentDescription = "Album art",
 modifier = Modifier
 .size(56.dp)
 .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
 contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
 )

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(12.dp))

 Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
 Text(
 text = song.title,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 Text(
 text = song.artist,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 }
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

 // Progress Bar
 var sliderPosition by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }

 LaunchedEffect(playerState.currentPosition) {
 sliderPosition = playerState.currentPosition.toFloat()
 }

 Slider(
 value = sliderPosition,
 onValueChange = { sliderPosition = it },
 onValueChangeFinished = { onSeek(sliderPosition.toLong()) },
 valueRange = 0f..playerState.duration.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f),
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
 )

 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
 ) {
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(sliderPosition.toLong()),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(playerState.duration),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

 // Playback Controls
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipPrevious,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipPrevious,
 contentDescription = "Previous",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }

 FilledIconButton(
 onClick = onPlayPauseClick,
 modifier = Modifier.size(64.dp),
 shape = CircleShape
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = if (playerState.isPlaying) Icons.Filled.Pause else Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = if (playerState.isPlaying) "Pause" else "Play",
 modifier = Modifier.size(36.dp)
 )
 }

 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipNext,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipNext,
 contentDescription = "Next",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

private fun formatDuration(millis: Long): String {
 val totalSeconds = millis / 1000
 val minutes = totalSeconds / 60
 val seconds = totalSeconds % 60
 return String.format("%d:%02d", minutes, seconds)
}

import android.content.ContentUris
import android.content.Context
import android.database.Cursor
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.MediaStore
import com.example.mediasessionplayer.domain.model.Song
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton
import androidx.core.net.toUri

@Singleton
class LocalMusicDataSource @Inject constructor(
 @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
) {

 fun getLocalSongs(): List<Song> {
 val songs = mutableListOf<Song>()

 val projection = arrayOf(
 MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID,
 MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE,
 MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST,
 MediaStore.Audio.Media.ALBUM,
 MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION,
 MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA,
 MediaStore.Audio.Media.ALBUM_ID
 )

 val selection = "${MediaStore.Audio.Media.IS_MUSIC} != 0"
 val sortOrder = "${MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE} ASC"

 val cursor: Cursor? = context.contentResolver.query(
 MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI,
 projection,
 selection,
 null,
 sortOrder
 )

 cursor?.use {
 val idColumn = it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID)
 val titleColumn = it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE)
 val artistColumn = it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST)
 val albumColumn = it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.ALBUM)
 val durationColumn = it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION)
 val dataColumn = it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA)
 val albumIdColumn = it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.ALBUM_ID)

 while (it.moveToNext()) {
 val id = it.getLong(idColumn)
 val title = it.getString(titleColumn) ?: "Unknown"
 val artist = it.getString(artistColumn) ?: "Unknown Artist"
 val album = it.getString(albumColumn) ?: "Unknown Album"
 val duration = it.getLong(durationColumn)
 val data = it.getString(dataColumn)
 val albumId = it.getLong(albumIdColumn)

 val contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(
 MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI,
 id
 )

 val albumArtUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(
 "content://media/external/audio/albumart".toUri(),
 albumId
 )

 songs.add(
 Song(
 id = id.toString(),
 title = title,
 artist = artist,
 album = album,
 duration = duration,
 imageUrl = albumArtUri.toString(),
 mediaUri = contentUri.toString()
 )
 )
 }
 }

 return songs
 }
}

import androidx.media3.session.MediaSession
import androidx.media3.session.MediaSessionService
import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint
import javax.inject.Inject

@AndroidEntryPoint
class MusicService : MediaSessionService() {

 @Inject
 lateinit var player: ExoPlayer

 private var mediaSession: MediaSession? = null

 override fun onCreate() {
 super.onCreate()

 val sessionActivityPendingIntent =
 packageManager?.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)?.let { sessionIntent ->
 PendingIntent.getActivity(
 this,
 0,
 sessionIntent,
 PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE or PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT
 )
 }

 mediaSession = MediaSession.Builder(this, player)
 .setSessionActivity(sessionActivityPendingIntent!!)
 .build()
 }

 override fun onGetSession(controllerInfo: MediaSession.ControllerInfo): MediaSession? {
 return mediaSession
 }

 override fun onDestroy() {
 mediaSession?.run {
 player.release()
 release()
 mediaSession = null
 }
 super.onDestroy()
 }
}

package com.example.mediasessionplayer.presentation.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.background

import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items

import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.PlayArrow
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.SkipNext
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.SkipPrevious
import androidx.compose.material3.*

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun MusicPlayerScreen(
 songs: List<Song>,
 playerState: PlayerState,
 onSongClick: (Song) -> Unit,
 onPlayPauseClick: () -> Unit,
 onSkipNext: () -> Unit,
 onSkipPrevious: () -> Unit,
 onSeek: (Long) -> Unit,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
 Column(
 modifier = modifier
 .fillMaxSize()
 .background(
 Brush.verticalGradient(
 colors = listOf(
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = 0.2f),
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background
 )
 )
 )
 .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.systemBars)
 ) {
 // App Bar
 TopAppBar(
 title = {
 Text(
 text = "Music Player",
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
 )
 },
 colors = TopAppBarDefaults.topAppBarColors(
 containerColor = Color.Transparent
 )
 )

 // Song List
 LazyColumn(
 modifier = Modifier
 .weight(1f)
 .fillMaxWidth(),
 contentPadding = PaddingValues(16.dp),
 verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
 ) {
 items(songs) { song ->
 SongItem(
 song = song,
 isCurrentSong = playerState.currentSong?.id == song.id,
 isPlaying = playerState.isPlaying && playerState.currentSong?.id == song.id,
 onClick = { onSongClick(song) }
 )
 }
 }

 // Player Controls
 if (playerState.currentSong != null) {
 MiniPlayer(
 playerState = playerState,
 onPlayPauseClick = onPlayPauseClick,
 onSkipNext = onSkipNext,
 onSkipPrevious = onSkipPrevious,
 onSeek = onSeek
 )
 }
 }
}

@Composable
fun SongItem(
 song: Song,
 isCurrentSong: Boolean,
 isPlaying: Boolean,
 onClick: () -> Unit,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
 Card(
 modifier = modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .clickable { onClick() },
 elevation = CardDefaults.cardElevation(
 defaultElevation = if (isCurrentSong) 8.dp else 2.dp
 ),
 colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
 containerColor = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
 ),
 shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
 ) {
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(12.dp),
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 // Album Art
 AsyncImage(
 model = song.imageUrl,
 contentDescription = "Album art for ${song.title}",
 modifier = Modifier
 .size(60.dp)
 .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)),
 contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
 )

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(12.dp))

 // Song Info
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
 ) {
 Text(
 text = song.title,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
 color = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
 )
 Text(
 text = song.artist,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
 color = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer.copy(alpha = 0.7f)
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 }

 // Playing indicator
 if (isPlaying) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = "Now playing",
 tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
 modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 }
}

@Composable
fun MiniPlayer(
 playerState: PlayerState,
 onPlayPauseClick: () -> Unit,
 onSkipNext: () -> Unit,
 onSkipPrevious: () -> Unit,
 onSeek: (Long) -> Unit,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
 val song = playerState.currentSong ?: return

 Surface(
 modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant,
 shadowElevation = 8.dp
 ) {
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(16.dp)
 ) {
 // Current Song Info
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 AsyncImage(
 model = song.imageUrl,
 contentDescription = "Album art",
 modifier = Modifier
 .size(56.dp)
 .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
 contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
 )

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(12.dp))

 Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
 Text(
 text = song.title,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 Text(
 text = song.artist,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 }
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

 // Progress Bar
 var sliderPosition by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }

 LaunchedEffect(playerState.currentPosition) {
 sliderPosition = playerState.currentPosition.toFloat()
 }

 Slider(
 value = sliderPosition,
 onValueChange = { sliderPosition = it },
 onValueChangeFinished = { onSeek(sliderPosition.toLong()) },
 valueRange = 0f..playerState.duration.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f),
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
 )

 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
 ) {
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(sliderPosition.toLong()),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(playerState.duration),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

 // Playback Controls
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipPrevious,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipPrevious,
 contentDescription = "Previous",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }

 FilledIconButton(
 onClick = onPlayPauseClick,
 modifier = Modifier.size(64.dp),
 shape = CircleShape
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = if (playerState.isPlaying) Icons.Filled.Pause else Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = if (playerState.isPlaying) "Pause" else "Play",
 modifier = Modifier.size(36.dp)
 )
 }

 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipNext,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipNext,
 contentDescription = "Next",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

private fun formatDuration(millis: Long): String {
 val totalSeconds = millis / 1000
 val minutes = totalSeconds / 60
 val seconds = totalSeconds % 60
 return String.format("%d:%02d", minutes, seconds)
}

package com.example.mediasessionplayer.presentation.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.CircleShape
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Pause
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.PlayArrow
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.SkipNext
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.SkipPrevious
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.layout.ContentScale
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextOverflow
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import coil.compose.AsyncImage
import com.example.mediasessionplayer.domain.model.PlayerState
import com.example.mediasessionplayer.domain.model.Song

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun MusicPlayerScreen(
 songs: List<Song>,
 playerState: PlayerState,
 onSongClick: (Song) -> Unit,
 onPlayPauseClick: () -> Unit,
 onSkipNext: () -> Unit,
 onSkipPrevious: () -> Unit,
 onSeek: (Long) -> Unit,
) {
 Scaffold(
 topBar = {
 TopAppBar(
 title = {
 Text(
 text = "Music Player",
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
 )
 },
 colors = TopAppBarDefaults.topAppBarColors(
 containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = 0.1f)
 )
 )
 },
 bottomBar = {
 if (playerState.currentSong != null) {
 MiniPlayer(
 playerState = playerState,
 onPlayPauseClick = onPlayPauseClick,
 onSkipNext = onSkipNext,
 onSkipPrevious = onSkipPrevious,
 onSeek = onSeek
 )
 }
 },
 containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background
 ) { paddingValues ->
 Box(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxSize()
 .padding(paddingValues)
 .background(
 Brush.verticalGradient(
 colors = listOf(
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = 0.1f),
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background
 )
 )
 )
 ) {
 LazyColumn(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
 contentPadding = PaddingValues(
 start = 16.dp,
 end = 16.dp,
 top = 16.dp,
 bottom = 16.dp
 ),
 verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
 ) {
 items(songs) { song ->
 SongItem(
 song = song,
 isCurrentSong = playerState.currentSong?.id == song.id,
 isPlaying = playerState.isPlaying && playerState.currentSong?.id == song.id,
 onClick = { onSongClick(song) }
 )
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

@Composable
fun SongItem(
 song: Song,
 isCurrentSong: Boolean,
 isPlaying: Boolean,
 onClick: () -> Unit,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
 Card(
 modifier = modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .clickable { onClick() },
 elevation = CardDefaults.cardElevation(
 defaultElevation = if (isCurrentSong) 8.dp else 2.dp
 ),
 colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
 containerColor = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
 ),
 shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
 ) {
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(12.dp),
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 // Album Art
 AsyncImage(
 model = song.imageUrl,
 contentDescription = "Album art for ${song.title}",
 modifier = Modifier
 .size(60.dp)
 .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)),
 contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
 )

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(12.dp))

 // Song Info
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
 ) {
 Text(
 text = song.title,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
 color = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
 )
 Text(
 text = song.artist,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
 color = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer.copy(alpha = 0.7f)
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 }

 // Playing indicator
 if (isPlaying) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = "Now playing",
 tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
 modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 }
}

@Composable
fun MiniPlayer(
 playerState: PlayerState,
 onPlayPauseClick: () -> Unit,
 onSkipNext: () -> Unit,
 onSkipPrevious: () -> Unit,
 onSeek: (Long) -> Unit,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
 val song = playerState.currentSong ?: return

 Surface(
 modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant,
 shadowElevation = 8.dp
 ) {
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(16.dp)
 ) {
 // Current Song Info
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 AsyncImage(
 model = song.imageUrl,
 contentDescription = "Album art",
 modifier = Modifier
 .size(56.dp)
 .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
 contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
 )

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(12.dp))

 Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
 Text(
 text = song.title,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 Text(
 text = song.artist,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 }
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

 // Progress Bar
 var sliderPosition by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }

 LaunchedEffect(playerState.currentPosition) {
 sliderPosition = playerState.currentPosition.toFloat()
 }

 Slider(
 value = sliderPosition,
 onValueChange = { sliderPosition = it },
 onValueChangeFinished = { onSeek(sliderPosition.toLong()) },
 valueRange = 0f..playerState.duration.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f),
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
 )

 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
 ) {
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(sliderPosition.toLong()),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(playerState.duration),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

 // Playback Controls
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipPrevious,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipPrevious,
 contentDescription = "Previous",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }

 FilledIconButton(
 onClick = onPlayPauseClick,
 modifier = Modifier.size(64.dp),
 shape = CircleShape
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = if (playerState.isPlaying) Icons.Filled.Pause else Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = if (playerState.isPlaying) "Pause" else "Play",
 modifier = Modifier.size(36.dp)
 )
 }

 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipNext,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipNext,
 contentDescription = "Next",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

private fun formatDuration(millis: Long): String {
 val totalSeconds = millis / 1000
 val minutes = totalSeconds / 60
 val seconds = totalSeconds % 60
 return String.format("%d:%02d", minutes, seconds)
}

 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 Text(
 text = song.artist,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 }
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

 // Progress Bar
 var sliderPosition by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }

 LaunchedEffect(playerState.currentPosition) {
 sliderPosition = playerState.currentPosition.toFloat()
 }

 Slider(
 value = sliderPosition,
 onValueChange = { sliderPosition = it },
 onValueChangeFinished = { onSeek(sliderPosition.toLong()) },
 valueRange = 0f..playerState.duration.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f),
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
 )

 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
 ) {
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(sliderPosition.toLong()),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(playerState.duration),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

 // Playback Controls
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipPrevious,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipPrevious,
 contentDescription = "Previous",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }

 FilledIconButton(
 onClick = onPlayPauseClick,
 modifier = Modifier.size(64.dp),
 shape = CircleShape
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = if (playerState.isPlaying) Icons.Filled.Pause else Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = if (playerState.isPlaying) "Pause" else "Play",
 modifier = Modifier.size(36.dp)
 )
 }

 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipNext,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipNext,
 contentDescription = "Next",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

private fun formatDuration(millis: Long): String {
 val totalSeconds = millis / 1000
 val minutes = totalSeconds / 60
 val seconds = totalSeconds % 60
 return String.format("%d:%02d", minutes, seconds)
}

+# Mejoras y Optimizaciones Finales
 
+Este documento detalla las mejoras y optimizaciones realizadas al reproductor de música.
+
+## ✅ Mejoras Implementadas
+
+### 1. Material Icons Extended
+
+**Problema anterior:**
+
+- Uso de iconos genéricos o no disponibles
+- Advertencias de deprecación en los iconos
+
+**Solución implementada:**
+
+```kotlin
+// Agregado en gradle/libs.versions.toml
+androidx-material-icons-extended = { 
+ group = "androidx.compose.material", 
+ name = "material-icons-extended" 
+}
+```
+
+**Beneficios:**
+
+- ✅ Acceso a más de 2,000 iconos de Material Design
+- ✅ Iconos correctos: `PlayArrow`, `Pause`, `SkipNext`, `SkipPrevious`
+- ✅ Sin warnings de deprecación
+- ✅ Consistencia con Material Design 3
+
+---
+
+### 2. Scaffold en lugar de Column
+
+**Problema anterior:**
+
+```kotlin
+// ❌ Enfoque manual con Column
+Column(
+ modifier = modifier
+ .fillMaxSize()
+ .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.systemBars) // Manual
+) {
+ TopAppBar(...)
+ LazyColumn(...)
+ if (playerState.currentSong != null) {
+ MiniPlayer(...)
+ }
+}
+```
+
+**Solución implementada:**
+
+```kotlin
+// ✅ Enfoque con Scaffold (Material Design 3)
+Scaffold(
+ topBar = { TopAppBar(...) },
+ bottomBar = { 
+ if (playerState.currentSong != null) {
+ MiniPlayer(...)
+ }
+ },
+ contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets.systemBars
+) { paddingValues ->
+ // Contenido con padding automático
+ Box(modifier = Modifier.padding(paddingValues)) {
+ LazyColumn(...)
+ }
+}
+```
+
+**Beneficios:**
+
+- ✅ Estructura estándar de Material Design 3
+- ✅ Manejo automático de insets (barras del sistema)
+- ✅ Código más limpio y mantenible
+- ✅ TopBar y BottomBar correctamente posicionados
+- ✅ Edge-to-edge correctamente implementado
+
+---
+
+### 3. Datos de Prueba
+
+**Problema anterior:**
+
+- Si el dispositivo no tiene música, la app muestra una lista vacía
+- Difícil de probar la UI sin música real
+
+**Solución implementada:**
+
+```kotlin
+override suspend fun getSongs(): List<Song> {
+ if (cachedSongs == null) {
+ val localSongs = localMusicDataSource.getLocalSongs()
+ 
+ // Si no hay canciones en el dispositivo, usar datos de prueba
+ cachedSongs = if (localSongs.isEmpty()) {
+ getTestSongs() // 15 canciones de prueba
+ } else {
+ localSongs
+ }
+ }
+ return cachedSongs ?: emptyList()
+}
+```
+
+**Canciones de prueba incluidas (15 canciones):**
+
+1. Blinding Lights - The Weeknd
+2. Shape of You - Ed Sheeran
+3. Someone Like You - Adele
+4. Levitating - Dua Lipa
+5. Uptown Funk - Mark Ronson ft. Bruno Mars
+6. Bohemian Rhapsody - Queen
+7. Starboy - The Weeknd ft. Daft Punk
+8. Perfect - Ed Sheeran
+9. Rolling in the Deep - Adele
+10. Break My Soul - Beyoncé
+11. As It Was - Harry Styles
+12. Bad Guy - Billie Eilish
+13. Circles - Post Malone
+14. Watermelon Sugar - Harry Styles
+15. Savage Love - Jawsh 685 x Jason Derulo
+
+**Beneficios:**
+
+- ✅ La app siempre tiene contenido para mostrar
+- ✅ Fácil de probar en emuladores sin música
+- ✅ Excelente para demos y screenshots
+- ✅ Usa URLs de audio reales (soundhelix.com)
+
+---
+
+### 4. Limpieza de Código
+
+**Imports eliminados:**
+
+```kotlin
+// ❌ Antes - Imports no utilizados
+import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.MusicNote
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
+import androidx.compose.material3.Surface
+import android.content.Intent
+import androidx.media3.common.MediaItem
+```
+
+**Código eliminado:**
+
+- Variables no usadas (`data` en LocalMusicDataSource)
+- Columnas innecesarias en MediaStore query
+- Imports redundantes en todos los archivos
+
+**Beneficios:**
+
+- ✅ Código más limpio y fácil de leer
+- ✅ Menos dependencias innecesarias
+- ✅ Mejor rendimiento de compilación
+- ✅ Sin warnings del IDE
+
+---
+
+## Comparación Antes vs Después
+
+### Manejo de Insets
+
+| Aspecto | ❌ Antes | ✅ Después |
+|---------|---------|-----------|
+| **Estructura** | Column manual | Scaffold (Material Design 3) |
+| **Insets** | Manual con `.windowInsetsPadding()` | Automático con `contentWindowInsets` |
+| **BottomBar** | Componente flotante | BottomBar nativo del Scaffold |
+| **Código** | ~100 líneas | ~70 líneas (más limpio) |
+
+### Iconos
+
+| Aspecto | ❌ Antes | ✅ Después |
+|---------|---------|-----------|
+| **Librería** | material-icons-core (~100 iconos) | material-icons-extended (+2,000 iconos) |
+| **Warnings** | Sí (deprecación) | No |
+| **Iconos usados** | ArrowBack/Forward (genéricos) | SkipPrevious/Next (específicos) |
+
+### Datos
+
+| Aspecto | ❌ Antes | ✅ Después |
+|---------|---------|-----------|
+| **Sin música** | Lista vacía | 15 canciones de prueba |
+| **Testing** | Difícil sin música | Fácil con datos de prueba |
+| **Demo** | Requiere música real | Funciona out-of-the-box |
+
+---
+
+## Mejores Prácticas Aplicadas
+
+### 1. Material Design 3 Guidelines
+
+✅ **Scaffold Structure**
+
+- TopAppBar para navegación
+- BottomBar para acciones persistentes
+- Contenido en el centro con padding correcto
+
+✅ **Window Insets**
+
+- `contentWindowInsets` en Scaffold
+- Respeta barras del sistema automáticamente
+- Edge-to-edge correctamente implementado
+
+### 2. Clean Architecture Mantenida
+
+```
+┌─────────────────────────────────┐
+│ Presentation (UI + ViewModel) │
+│ - Scaffold structure │
+│ - Material Icons Extended │
+└─────────────────────────────────┘
+ ↓ ↑
+┌─────────────────────────────────┐
+│ Domain (Use Cases + Entities) │
+│ - Sin cambios (independiente) │
+└─────────────────────────────────┘
+ ↓ ↑
+┌─────────────────────────────────┐
+│ Data (Repositories + Sources) │
+│ - Test data fallback │
+│ - Código limpio │
+└─────────────────────────────────┘
+```
+
+### 3. Compose Best Practices
+
+✅ **Composable Functions**
+
+- Componentes pequeños y reutilizables
+- Estados hoisted correctamente
+- Modifiers pasados como parámetro
+
+✅ **State Management**
+
+- StateFlow para estados reactivos
+- LaunchedEffect para side effects
+- remember para estados locales
+
+---
+
+## Resultado Final
+
+### Características de la UI
+
+- ✅ **Edge-to-Edge**: Aprovecha toda la pantalla
+- ✅ **System Bars**: Respeta barras de navegación y status bar
+- ✅ **Material Design 3**: Sigue todas las guías
+- ✅ **Scaffold**: Estructura correcta y estándar
+- ✅ **Responsive**: Se adapta a cualquier dispositivo
+- ✅ **Gradiente**: Fondo atractivo y moderno
+- ✅ **Iconos**: +2,000 iconos disponibles
+- ✅ **Test Data**: Siempre hay contenido para mostrar
+
+### Código Limpio
+
+- ✅ Sin imports no utilizados
+- ✅ Sin variables no utilizadas
+- ✅ Sin warnings del compilador
+- ✅ Código organizado y legible
+- ✅ Sigue convenciones de Kotlin
+
+### Funcionalidad Completa
+
+- ✅ Lee música real del dispositivo
+- ✅ Fallback a datos de prueba
+- ✅ Reproducción en background
+- ✅ Controles completos
+- ✅ Seek bar funcional
+- ✅ Actualización en tiempo real
+
+---
+
+## Comandos Útiles
+
+### Compilar
+
+```bash
+./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
+```
+
+### Limpiar y Compilar
+
+```bash
+./gradlew clean :app:assembleDebug
+```
+
+### Ver dependencias
+
+```bash
+./gradlew :app:dependencies
+```
+
+---
+
+## Lecciones Aprendidas
+
+1. **Usar Scaffold siempre** para pantallas con TopBar/BottomBar
+2. **contentWindowInsets** maneja insets mejor que manualmente
+3. **material-icons-extended** vale la pena para apps de producción
+4. **Datos de prueba** facilitan desarrollo y testing
+5. **Limpiar imports** regularmente mejora el código
+
+---
+
+## Referencias
+
+- [Scaffold - Material Design 3](https://developer.android.com/jetpack/compose/layouts/material#scaffold)
+- [Window Insets - Compose](https://developer.android.com/jetpack/compose/layouts/insets)
+- [Material Icons Extended](https://developer.android.com/jetpack/compose/graphics/images/material-icons)
+- [Clean Architecture - Android](https://developer.android.com/topic/architecture)
+
+---
+
+**¡El proyecto está completo y siguiendo las mejores prácticas!** 
+

package com.example.mediasessionplayer.presentation.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.CircleShape
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.Pause
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.PlayArrow
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.SkipNext
import androidx.compose.material.icons.filled.SkipPrevious
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.layout.ContentScale
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextAlign
import androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextOverflow
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import coil.compose.AsyncImage
import com.example.mediasessionplayer.domain.model.PlayerState
import com.example.mediasessionplayer.domain.model.Song

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun MusicPlayerScreen(
 songs: List<Song>,
 playerState: PlayerState,
 onSongClick: (Song) -> Unit,
 onPlayPauseClick: () -> Unit,
 onSkipNext: () -> Unit,
 onSkipPrevious: () -> Unit,
 onSeek: (Long) -> Unit,
) {
 Scaffold(
 topBar = {
 TopAppBar(
 title = {
 Text(
 text = "Music Player",
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
 )
 },
 colors = TopAppBarDefaults.topAppBarColors(
 containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = 0.1f)
 )
 )
 },
 bottomBar = {
 if (playerState.currentSong != null) {
 MiniPlayer(
 playerState = playerState,
 onPlayPauseClick = onPlayPauseClick,
 onSkipNext = onSkipNext,
 onSkipPrevious = onSkipPrevious,
 onSeek = onSeek
 )
 }
 },
 contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets.systemBars,
 containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background
 ) { paddingValues ->
 Box(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxSize()
 .padding(paddingValues)
 .background(
 Brush.verticalGradient(
 colors = listOf(
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = 0.1f),
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background
 )
 )
 )
 ) {
 LazyColumn(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
 contentPadding = PaddingValues(
 start = 16.dp,
 end = 16.dp,
 top = 16.dp,
 bottom = 16.dp
 ),
 verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
 ) {
 if (songs.isEmpty()) {
 item {
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(vertical = 64.dp),
 horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
 verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = null,
 modifier = Modifier.size(80.dp),
 tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = 0.3f)
 )
 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
 Text(
 text = "No music found",
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
 )
 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
 Text(
 text = "Add music files to your device",
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground.copy(alpha = 0.7f),
 textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
 modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 32.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 } else {
 items(songs) { song ->
 SongItem(
 song = song,
 isCurrentSong = playerState.currentSong?.id == song.id,
 isPlaying = playerState.isPlaying && playerState.currentSong?.id == song.id,
 onClick = { onSongClick(song) }
 )
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

@Composable
fun SongItem(
 song: Song,
 isCurrentSong: Boolean,
 isPlaying: Boolean,
 onClick: () -> Unit,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
 Card(
 modifier = modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .clickable { onClick() },
 elevation = CardDefaults.cardElevation(
 defaultElevation = if (isCurrentSong) 8.dp else 2.dp
 ),
 colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
 containerColor = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
 ),
 shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
 ) {
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(12.dp),
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 // Album Art
 AsyncImage(
 model = song.imageUrl,
 contentDescription = "Album art for ${song.title}",
 modifier = Modifier
 .size(60.dp)
 .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)),
 contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
 )

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(12.dp))

 // Song Info
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
 ) {
 Text(
 text = song.title,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
 color = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
 )
 Text(
 text = song.artist,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
 color = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer.copy(alpha = 0.7f)
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 }

 // Playing indicator
 if (isPlaying) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = "Now playing",
 tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
 modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 }
}

@Composable
fun MiniPlayer(
 playerState: PlayerState,
 onPlayPauseClick: () -> Unit,
 onSkipNext: () -> Unit,
 onSkipPrevious: () -> Unit,
 onSeek: (Long) -> Unit,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
 val song = playerState.currentSong ?: return

 Surface(
 modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant,
 shadowElevation = 8.dp
 ) {
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(16.dp)
 ) {
 // Current Song Info
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 AsyncImage(
 model = song.imageUrl,
 contentDescription = "Album art",
 modifier = Modifier
 .size(56.dp)
 .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
 contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
 )

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(12.dp))

 Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
 Text(
 text = song.title,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 Text(
 text = song.artist,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 }
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

 // Progress Bar
 var sliderPosition by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }

 LaunchedEffect(playerState.currentPosition) {
 sliderPosition = playerState.currentPosition.toFloat()
 }

 Slider(
 value = sliderPosition,
 onValueChange = { sliderPosition = it },
 onValueChangeFinished = { onSeek(sliderPosition.toLong()) },
 valueRange = 0f..playerState.duration.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f),
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
 )

 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
 ) {
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(sliderPosition.toLong()),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(playerState.duration),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

 // Playback Controls
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipPrevious,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipPrevious,
 contentDescription = "Previous",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }

 FilledIconButton(
 onClick = onPlayPauseClick,
 modifier = Modifier.size(64.dp),
 shape = CircleShape
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = if (playerState.isPlaying) Icons.Filled.Pause else Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = if (playerState.isPlaying) "Pause" else "Play",
 modifier = Modifier.size(36.dp)
 )
 }

 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipNext,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipNext,
 contentDescription = "Next",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

private fun formatDuration(millis: Long): String {
 val totalSeconds = millis / 1000
 val minutes = totalSeconds / 60
 val seconds = totalSeconds % 60
 return String.format("%d:%02d", minutes, seconds)
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun MusicPlayerScreen(
 songs: List<Song>,
 playerState: PlayerState,
 onSongClick: (Song) -> Unit,
 onPlayPauseClick: () -> Unit,
 onSkipNext: () -> Unit,
 onSkipPrevious: () -> Unit,
 onSeek: (Long) -> Unit,
) {
 Scaffold(
 topBar = {
 TopAppBar(
 title = {
 Text(
 text = "Music Player",
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
 )
 },
 colors = TopAppBarDefaults.topAppBarColors(
 containerColor = Color.Transparent
 )
 )
 },
 bottomBar = {
 if (playerState.currentSong != null) {
 MiniPlayer(
 playerState = playerState,
 onPlayPauseClick = onPlayPauseClick,
 onSkipNext = onSkipNext,
 onSkipPrevious = onSkipPrevious,
 onSeek = onSeek
 )
 }
 },
 contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets.systemBars,
 containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background
 ) { paddingValues ->
 Box(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxSize()
 .padding(paddingValues)
 .background(
 Brush.verticalGradient(
 colors = listOf(
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface,
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background
 )
 )
 )
 ) {
 LazyColumn(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
 contentPadding = PaddingValues(
 start = 16.dp,
 end = 16.dp,
 top = 16.dp,
 bottom = 16.dp
 ),
 verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
 ) {
 if (songs.isEmpty()) {
 item {
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(vertical = 64.dp),
 horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
 verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = null,
 modifier = Modifier.size(80.dp),
 tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = 0.3f)
 )
 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
 Text(
 text = "No music found",
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
 )
 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
 Text(
 text = "Add music files to your device",
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground.copy(alpha = 0.7f),
 textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
 modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 32.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 } else {
 items(songs) { song ->
 SongItem(
 song = song,
 isCurrentSong = playerState.currentSong?.id == song.id,
 isPlaying = playerState.isPlaying && playerState.currentSong?.id == song.id,
 onClick = { onSongClick(song) }
 )
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

@Composable
fun SongItem(
 song: Song,
 isCurrentSong: Boolean,
 isPlaying: Boolean,
 onClick: () -> Unit,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
 Card(
 modifier = modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .clickable { onClick() },
 elevation = CardDefaults.cardElevation(
 defaultElevation = if (isCurrentSong) 8.dp else 2.dp
 ),
 colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
 containerColor = if (isCurrentSong)
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer
 else
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
 ),
 shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)

 ) {

 )

@Composable
fun MiniPlayer(
 playerState: PlayerState,
 onPlayPauseClick: () -> Unit,
 onSkipNext: () -> Unit,
 onSkipPrevious: () -> Unit,
 onSeek: (Long) -> Unit,
 modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
 val song = playerState.currentSong ?: return

 Surface(
 modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant,
 shadowElevation = 8.dp
 ) {
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(16.dp)
 ) {
 // Current Song Info
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 AsyncImage(
 model = song.imageUrl,
 contentDescription = "Album art",
 modifier = Modifier
 .size(56.dp)
 .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
 contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
 )

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(12.dp))

 Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
 Text(
 text = song.title,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 Text(
 text = song.artist,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 }
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

 // Progress Bar
 var sliderPosition by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }

 LaunchedEffect(playerState.currentPosition) {
 sliderPosition = playerState.currentPosition.toFloat()
 }

 Slider(
 value = sliderPosition,
 onValueChange = { sliderPosition = it },
 onValueChangeFinished = { onSeek(sliderPosition.toLong()) },
 valueRange = 0f..playerState.duration.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f),
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
 )

 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
 ) {
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(sliderPosition.toLong()),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(playerState.duration),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

 // Playback Controls
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,
 verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
 ) {
 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipPrevious,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipPrevious,
 contentDescription = "Previous",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }

 FilledIconButton(
 onClick = onPlayPauseClick,
 modifier = Modifier.size(64.dp),
 shape = CircleShape
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = if (playerState.isPlaying) Icons.Filled.Pause else Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = if (playerState.isPlaying) "Pause" else "Play",
 modifier = Modifier.size(36.dp)
 )
 }

 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipNext,
 modifier = Modifier.size(56.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipNext,
 contentDescription = "Next",
 modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
 )
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

private fun formatDuration(millis: Long): String {
 val totalSeconds = millis / 1000
 val minutes = totalSeconds / 60
 val seconds = totalSeconds % 60
 return String.format("%d:%02d", minutes, seconds)
}

 playerState: PlayerState,

) {
 val song = playerState.currentSong ?: return

 Column(
 modifier = modifier
 .fillMaxSize()
 .background(
 Brush.verticalGradient(

 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant,
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background,
 MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background
 )
 )
 )
 .statusBarsPadding()

 ) {
 // Header con botón de cerrar
 Row(

 .fillMaxWidth()

 )
 }
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))

 // Carátula grande
 Box(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .aspectRatio(1f)

 contentDescription = "Album art",
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxSize()
 .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
 contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
 )
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(32.dp))

 // Información de la canción
 Column(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(horizontal = 32.dp)
 ) {
 Text(
 text = song.title,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall,
 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
 maxLines = 2,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
 )
 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
 Text(
 text = song.artist,
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
 maxLines = 1,
 overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
 )
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(32.dp))

 // Progress Bar
 var sliderPosition by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }

 LaunchedEffect(playerState.currentPosition) {
 sliderPosition = playerState.currentPosition.toFloat()
 }

 Column(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(horizontal = 32.dp)
 ) {
 Slider(
 value = sliderPosition,
 onValueChange = { sliderPosition = it },
 onValueChangeFinished = { onSeek(sliderPosition.toLong()) },
 valueRange = 0f..playerState.duration.toFloat().coerceAtLeast(1f),
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 colors = SliderDefaults.colors(
 thumbColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground,
 activeTrackColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground,
 inactiveTrackColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.3f)
 )
 )

 Row(
 modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
 horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
 ) {
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(sliderPosition.toLong()),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 Text(
 text = formatDuration(playerState.duration),
 style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
 color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
 )
 }
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))

 // Controles de reproducción
 Row(
 modifier = Modifier
 .fillMaxWidth()
 .padding(horizontal = 32.dp),

 Icon(

 tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
 )
 }

 modifier = Modifier.size(80.dp),
 shape = CircleShape,
 colors = IconButtonDefaults.filledIconButtonColors(
 containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground,
 contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background
 )
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = if (playerState.isPlaying) Icons.Filled.Pause else Icons.Filled.PlayArrow,
 contentDescription = if (playerState.isPlaying) "Pause" else "Play",
 modifier = Modifier.size(40.dp)
 )
 }

 IconButton(
 onClick = onSkipNext,
 modifier = Modifier.size(64.dp)
 ) {
 Icon(
 imageVector = Icons.Filled.SkipNext,
 contentDescription = "Next",
 modifier = Modifier.size(40.dp),
 tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
 )
 }
 }

 Spacer(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
 }
}

private fun formatDuration(millis: Long): String {
 val totalSeconds = millis / 1000
 val minutes = totalSeconds / 60
 val seconds = totalSeconds % 60
 return String.format("%d:%02d", minutes, seconds)
